description.p: Housekeeper brings desktop applications from different installation sources into one native, searchable inventory.

ul.li: Browse applications in a list or an icon grid.
Sort applications by name, software size, or Last Updated.
Inspect installation sources, package identities, file locations, and software sizes.
Open applications from their details page and see available updates beside their names.
Identify installed DEB, Pacman, APK, and Snap packages with external management guidance.
View app icon themes and customize or restore launcher icons.
See native package source labels matched to the distribution, with guidance for unsupported providers.
Review removal plans for RPM packages, Flatpak applications, and independent AppImages.
Check for RPM and Flatpak updates, then confirm versions and dependency changes before updating.
Select applications in Updates or update all available applications together.
Choose manual or on-entry update checks, daily or weekly intervals, and participating RPM and Flatpak sources.
Find browser and Steam management instructions.

description.p: System package removal requires a compatible PackageKit backend and a verified removal preview. Unsupported operations provide manual management guidance. Other sources remain available when their integration is installed. Personal application data is kept by default; Flatpak removal can also delete the current user's app data and permissions.
Choose whether to keep user data when uninstalling a Flatpak application.

ul.li: Keep settings, files, cache, and permissions by default, or explicitly delete them after successful uninstall.
Explain that user data is shared across the application's Flatpak installations and branches.
Report incomplete data or permission cleanup separately from a successful uninstall.

description.p: Open applications directly and simplify application details.

ul.li: Open applications through their desktop launchers, preserving browser profiles and offering a choice when multiple launchers exist.
Show an update symbol beside the application name when an update is available, with update actions on the Updates page.
Open the selected Chrome or Chromium web app for management through its own menu.
Refresh the Housekeeper icon and show source-tree icons correctly in development builds.

description.p: Disclose what an update changes before it is applied.

ul.li: Name the sandbox permissions a Flatpak update adds before granting them.
Report which running programs a package update would replace, and stop if one started after the preview.
Complete Flatpak updates that include a repair operation instead of reporting them as partial.
Label an application's update action for what it will do once a check has found one.

description.p: Improve application management reliability and clarify update confirmation.

ul.li: Keep unrelated inventory changes marked for a fresh update check after completed updates.
Show consistent versions and affected application names, with complete targets in centered transaction Details.
Honor removal cancellation during setup and verify RPM D-Bus service overrides before management.
Report failed dpkg scans accurately and support AppImages on systems without a supported package database.
Reduce repeated inventory work, improve plural forms, and repair type-checking and GTK test gates.

description.p: Check desktop application updates with fewer repeated queries and simpler confirmation dialogs.

ul.li: Discover Flatpak updates once per installation and query RPM updates once per check, preparing full previews only for matching applications.
Hide auxiliary launchers such as LibreOffice XSLT filters and avoid presenting runtime-only changes as application updates.
Keep required dependencies in update plans and apply the same application filtering to cached results.
Show concise application names and version changes, with complete transaction and authorization information behind a centered Details expander.

description.p: Recognize application installations more accurately and verify ownership before management.

ul.li: Fix duplicate Flatpak and Other entries for D-Bus applications such as Gapless, preserving custom icons.
Verify Flatpak launch targets and effective D-Bus services, and reject previews when their ownership changes.
Resolve package ownership independently of provider order and disable direct management when sources conflict.
Keep distinct application components visible while managing their shared installation once.
Honor empty XDG defaults and supported env options, and verify AppImage format and package ownership before Trash.

description.p: Use a simpler header and choose when the application list refreshes.

ul.li: Open search from the sidebar header and find the main menu beside the Housekeeper title.
Access refresh and sorting at the start of the content header, with the sidebar button first in narrow windows.
Open Preferences with Ctrl+comma and choose automatic or manual application-list refresh.
Distinguish hidden applications by their semi-transparent icons in list and grid views.

description.p: Keep remaining updates visible and recognize more RPM application launchers.

ul.li: Remove successfully updated apps from cached results and retain remaining updates and selections.
Keep unfinished updates available after partial failures or cancellation.
Recognize shared and D-Bus launchers used by LibreOffice, GNOME Maps, and GNOME Weather.
Verify RPM launcher contents and package relationships before direct management, with instructions when verification is unavailable.

description.p: Find applications with remembered sorting and control how Housekeeper checks for updates.

ul.li: Sort list and grid views by name, software size, or Last Updated, with unknown values last.
Read Flatpak deployment dates from matching local journal records and show Last Updated in app details.
Simplify the header and keep view switching accessible in narrow windows.
Choose checks on opening Updates or manual checks only, with daily or weekly intervals.
Enable RPM and Flatpak update checks independently and match cached results to the selected sources.

description.p: See installed software sizes across more package formats and check updates without flickering controls.

ul.li: Show software sizes for RPM, DEB, Pacman, APK, Flatpak, Snap, and AppImage installations.
Identify DEB, Pacman, APK, and Snap applications from installed metadata, including Pacman-registered AUR builds.
Use one overall update-check progress bar and keep the progress window size stable.
Keep Cancel enabled during checks and disable it once after a cancellation request.

description.p: Customize application icons and find clearer source and appearance information.

ul.li: Choose persistent launcher icons, restore originals, and see GNOME app-grid refresh guidance.
Show app icon themes and launcher theme overrides in Appearance, with icon paths in Technical Details.
Adapt native source labels to the distribution, including DEB on Ubuntu and RPM on Fedora.
Keep list and grid content spacing while extending scrollbars and overshoot effects to the page edges.
Refresh screenshots and preserve verified package attribution for icon-only launcher overrides.

description.p: Reuse update results and enjoy a simpler, more consistent interface.

ul.li: Save update checks across restarts and refresh on page entry after 24 hours.
Keep previous results and selections when a check is cancelled, with simpler Cancel feedback.
Move update actions and selection status to an adaptive footer and shorten page descriptions.
Use single-layer grid highlights, rounded list highlights, and native pill-button hover effects.

description.p: Review and apply application updates from the details page or the new Updates sidebar page.

ul.li: Preview RPM and Flatpak updates, including dependencies, then update selected apps or all available apps.
Support system Flatpak authorization and cancellation during extra-data downloads, with verified and partial results.
Add system authentication guidance and local diagnostic logs, and keep development resources current at startup.
Improve narrow-window controls and remove ellipses from interface text.
Fix SVG icon-loading startup crashes while preserving icon themes and scaling.
Rename System Packages to RPM to distinguish installation source from scope.
Add repeated icon startup regression checks and refresh screenshots.
